summary: Voyager Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement entered in connection with its de-SPAC transaction with Veraxa Biotech AG. Under the agreement, PubCo will issue $27.5M in senior secured notes due 2027 and warrants to purchase up to 2,391,305 ordinary shares in a private placement exempt under Rule 506(b). This is a financing component of the business combination agreement dated April 22, 2025, where Voyager will merge into Merger Sub. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on successful completion of the de-SPAC and note conversion terms.
